title: Quadratic sparsity threshold representation
statement: Let $n$ be a positive integer and let $\varphi$ be a DNF formula on $n$ sign-valued Boolean variables. There is a real-valued polynomial on the Boolean cube whose threshold sign agrees with the function computed by $\varphi$ at every input, and whose Fourier sparsity is at most $17n$ times the square of the number of terms of $\varphi$.
hypotheses_covered: $\varphi$ is a DNF formula on $n$ variables
